Questions

Which WageGrid metro has the highest Physical therapists annual median?

Seattle-Tacoma-Bellevue, WA has the highest published OEWS May 2025 annual median for Physical Therapists ($107,290). Among metros with a published median: Seattle $107,290, Chicago $105,720, Austin $103,630. WageGrid does not rank suppressed cells or invent a missing wage.

Which WageGrid metro employs the most Physical therapists?

Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN has the highest published OEWS May 2025 employment for Physical Therapists (7,880 wage-and-salary workers). Published employment: Chicago 7,880, Seattle 2,950, Austin 2,470. Self-employed workers are excluded.

Where are Physical therapists most concentrated relative to the national mix?

Austin has the highest published location quotient (1.11). Published LQs: Austin 1.11, Chicago 1.02, Seattle 0.82.

What is the hourly median for Physical therapists in each metro?

OEWS May 2025 hourly medians: Austin $49.82; Chicago $50.83; Seattle $51.58. Blank means BLS withheld the estimate.

Does this comparison include self-employed workers?

No. OEWS covers wage-and-salary workers and excludes the self-employed. WageGrid does not add a self-employment estimate.

U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics, May 2025. WageGrid is not affiliated with BLS. Blank cells are BLS suppressions, not estimates.
